item.title: Maine's black market for baby eels
item.description:
📝 Josh Viertel and his father, Jack Viertel, wrote “The Glass Eel,” a mystery novel about the elver black market that is set in Maine. 25 million worth of elvers, including many in Maine. Jack and Joshua Viertel believe stories about illegal glass eel trafficking in Maine are begging to be written.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pressherald.com/2025/09/09/maines-black-market-for-baby-eels-is-spawning-a-crime-thriller-subgenre/
